text:
Lina (CS): Kicking off Northwind Logistics onboarding. Goals: sandbox + VPC peering, SSO, and first E2E chat integration within 14 days. Also need an enablement for their support team. Who can own owners and timelines?
Harold (CSM): I can run the stakeholder RACI and success criteria. Propose weekly Tue 20-min sync at 10am PT.
Alex (Northwind): Hey all — Alex from Northwind. Our tight points: legal/compliance review and limited peering maintenance windows. We also require audit logs retained 180 days.
Diego (Solutions): I'll take technical lead. Need SSO metadata, sample 2-min convo, expected QPS and CIDR(s). Also please confirm whether you'll primarily use generation routes.
Priya (Security): I'll shepherd the compliance questionnaire. 180d retention will likely need an export/archive plan; flagging potential legal review. Any regulated data in prompts?
Lina (CS): Owners assigned: Harold -> stakeholder comms & renewal watch; Diego -> integration lead; Priya -> compliance sign-off; Lina -> milestones, runbook & board upkeep; Alex -> provide artifacts and SRE contact.
Alex (Northwind): SSO contact: idp-admin@northwind.co. We'll upload CIDR and a sample convo by EOD. No regulated data expected.
Diego (Solutions): Proposed timeline:
Day 0: Kickoff + collect creds (SSO/KMS/CIDR/test accounts)
Day 2-3: Sandbox + VPC peering + smoke auth
Day 6-7: E2E integration test + perf baseline
Day 10: Observability + dashboard seed + runbook draft
Day 14: Enablement + customer sign-off
Harold (CSM): Proposed success criteria: authenticated calls from Northwind sandbox; E2E test passes; p95 latency within target; dashboard shows cost metrics; enablement session recorded and playbook delivered. Renewal watch set at 90/60/30/14 days.
Lina (CS): Risks noted: compliance >10 days elevates renewal risk; peering windows may add 48-72h. Adding contingency to Week 1 plan.
scheduler-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Northwind Onboarding - Deep Dive" Wed 11:00am PT. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood-internal/meet/northwind
Alex (Northwind): We'll upload artifacts to the shared doc and tag Harold + Diego.
Lina (CS): Next steps: 1) Alex shares artifacts (EOD), 2) Diego prepares test plan + perf targets, 3) Priya reviews questionnaire. Reconnect after deep-dive to lock Week 1 tasks. If anything blocks, post updates here. :rocket:
